faq.question: Which courses does Fobas Institute offer?
faq.answer: Fobas Institute offers the Diploma in Oil and Gas, Focused Oil and Gas Diploma, X-Ray Quality Welding (TIG/MIG/ARC), Diploma in Fire & Safety, Diploma and PG Diploma in Logistics, QA/QC Mechanical (with NDT Level 2 and Pipeline Engineering as additional certification courses) and AI Integrated Hospital Administration.

faq.question: Where is Fobas Institute located?
faq.answer: Fobas Institute has its head office in Palayam, Kozhikode, Kerala (3rd floor, Bethel Building, Kallai Rd, Tali) and a branch in Kadavanthra, Kochi (2nd floor, Parayanthra Building, KP Vallon Rd).

faq.question: What does the QA/QC Mechanical course include?
faq.answer: QA/QC Mechanical covers QA/QC welding inspection, QA/QC piping inspection and basics of industrial safety. NDT Level 2 (ASNT-NDT: PT, MPT, RT, UT, RTFI, VT) and Pipeline Engineering are offered as additional certification courses under it.

faq.question: What are the duration and eligibility of the Diploma in Oil and Gas?
faq.answer: The Diploma in Oil and Gas is a 6 month programme for Diploma, B.Tech or ITI candidates. It covers oil and gas engineering, refining process, rig operation, piping and pipeline engineering, ASNT-NDT Level 2, QA/QC welding and piping, and fire and safety.

faq.question: Does Fobas provide placement assistance?
faq.answer: Yes. Fobas offers 100% placement assistance, free career guidance and interview training. Our students have been placed with companies such as Saudi Aramco, Reliance Industries, Bharat Petroleum, Hindustan Petroleum, Saipem, ADNOC, Qatargas and Adani Pipeline.

faq.question: How can I enquire or get free career guidance?
faq.answer: Call +91 86067 97539 or +91 86062 30535, message us on WhatsApp, or fill in the enquiry form on the Contact page. Career guidance is free.
